page.layout: Running head at top with page number left and title right; main text in one column with a centred inscription in capitals; one marginal note at left beside the inscription; running prose below; catchword "jam" at right foot.

main_text.p: clo. Io. Eid. ejusdem mensis Mariae Anglicae exequiis assimilitas, funestis solemnibus, & lugubri pompâ celebratas.LXVIII.

Neq; Ferdinandus Albanus Iemminghanâ victoriâ ac prosperitate fortunæ elatior à statuendis quoq; immanibus exemplis cessabat. Quippe post præclaros per Brabantiam necatos viros, Culenborgiorum Comitum palatium quod Bruxellis visebatur, ob pactum in eo (de quo dixi) Fœdus, ac conventus Principum habitos, dirui jussit, & ut ipse in conscientijs non tantum temporum, sed & monumentis quoque perennaret, poni curavit hoc ipsum cum inscriptione:
main_text.head: REGNANTE PHILIPPO II. CATHOLICO HISPANIARUM REGE, IN HÆREDITARIIS BELGII PROVINCIIS GUBERNATORE FERDINANDO ALVARES TOLETANO, DUCE ALVÆ, MARCHIONE CORIAE, &c. DECRETUM FLORENTII PALLANTIS, COMITIS CULENBURGII PALATIUM, PROPTER DETESTANDAM IN EO CONIVERATIONEM HABITAM, ADVERSUS ROM. CATHOL. RELIG. REGEM HISPANIARUM, STATUMQUE BELGII, SOLO ÆQUANDUM.
main_text.p: Deïn ne vestigia fœderis ullibi cernerentur, eiusque memoriam deleret necatis autoribus, omnes fœderi adscriptos qui in Erisiâ permanserant, VIII. Kal. Sept. edicto Antverpiam evocavit, intraq; trigesimum diem ad dicendam causam adesse jussit. In eorum numero, qui citati erant, Deitzius Wingia, Watzo Aylva, Wigerus Eelsma, Titus Hettingha, Tiepco Goslingha, Tetardus Iellersma, Taco Galama, Sixtus Emingha, Schelto Tiarda, Sixtus Donia, Scipio Meckama, Serapius Galama, Ridco Hysingha, Otto Herama, Oeno Grovensteinius, Lasius Heringa, Iorritius Hania, Upco Burmania, Edo Abbema, Idzardus Douma, Gellius Ridderma, Ioannes Bonga, Hesselus Emingha, Oeno Heringha, Horatius Unia, Ielto Eelsma, Gemma Burmania, Ægydius Iacobæus, Fredericus Offenhusanus, Franciscus Gerritius, Foppius Douma, Focco Eysingha, Erasmus Douma, Edo Gerbranda, Douwo Douma, Botto Emingha, Atteius Fernia, Alephus Iaersma, Aggæus Ofingha, & Auco Unia fuere. Quos omnes asperitate fori, & magnitudine periculi deterritos, Fecconem Rhalam, & Georgium Godefridum in suprema Curia causarum patronos Antverpiam misisse; qui suo nomine responderent, patriæ Historiæ jam

page.notes: Marginal note at left beside inscription reads "Monumentum diruti Palatij." Ornamental initials and some letters in the inscription are damaged; the inscription is set in spaced capitals. Some words in the first paragraph are faint and uncertain.
